items.html: *Now, when the correction of the eighth king, Hadar, came, he began to purify from them the sparks and the vessels as well, and all that he purified from them was only the parts of the female in all the Partzufim. For at first, through the aforementioned Ibur of the upper one, he began to purify the most select of them all, and from it the female of Atik was made, after the light of the 288 sparks mixed with the light of the point of Keter that remained in Atzilut, and also the vessels of the kings mixed with the new vessels of the new MA, and from all of this the female of Atik, and Atik, were made, and so likewise in all of them.
